text:
Priya (Finance): Following the postmortem, we need concrete owners and dates for the token-count remediation across three workstreams: backfill for delayed ingest, invoice adjustments for impacted customers, and telemetry/fail-safes to prevent recurrence. Please ack and state availability.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Ack — I can take the backfill and corrected token computations. I need access to raw ingress logs + tokenizer mapping table. Estimate: get readable CSV of deltas within 48 hours after logs are exported.

Maya (Billing): I will handle invoice corrections and credit issuance. I need final per-customer deltas from Ashwin by Tue 17:00 PT to issue corrected invoices before the next billing cycle.

Sam (Eng-SRE): I'll own alerting gaps and the operational runbook updates. Will add a detection rule for ingestion lag > 10m and a kill-switch to block misrouted batches. Also will schedule a canary during the backfill window.

Leo (Platform): I looked into the pipeline: saw spikes in retry queue coinciding with an autoscaler flapping event on 2025-11-12 ~02:14 UTC. Short-term mitigation: pin min-replicas=3 for metering-api and add token-bucket backpressure. I'll open a PR today for the k8s change.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-4301 created: "Token ingest backfill + billing corrections" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Priya (Finance): For comms, we'll keep language simple and transparent: apology, summary of impact, credit amount, and link to appendix with calculation. I will draft a template — delivery Tue 09:00 PT.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): I started the logs export to s3://redwood-metering/exports/2025-11-10-12.tar.gz. Planned backfill script (dry-run then live) below: 

```
# backfill-runner (dry-run then apply)
metering-backfill --from 2025-11-10 --to 2025-11-12 --dry-run --out deltas.csv
```

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Will post CSV of per-customer token deltas once dry-run validates.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Proposed maintenance window: Wed 00:30-01:30 UTC (low traffic). I'll be on-call and monitor tail latency + token delta anomalies. Also adding dashboard panel for ingestion lag by region.

Maya (Billing): Ballpark refund/credit number for now: ~$8.4k across two accounts. Hold until Ashwin publishes deltas.

Priya (Finance): Summarizing owners & dates for the postmortem action tracker:
- Ashwin (Eng-ML): backfill and per-customer corrected token counts — target: Wed EOD (confirm after dry-run)
- Sam (Eng-SRE): alerting/runbook + dashboard — PR by Tue close of day
- Leo (Platform): resiliency changes (k8s replicas + backpressure) — PR by Mon midday
- Maya (Billing): invoice adjustments + customer comms — deliverables by Tue COB
I will update the postmortem doc and loop in Legal for the customer message.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Dry-run complete. CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-metering/deltas/1767778888-deltas.csv. A few accounts show >5% unexpected deltas, will validate.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Ack. I've added automated alert thresholds and will create the runbook PR.

LedgerBot: Reminder: FI-4301 check-in in 48h.

Maya (Billing): Thanks everyone. Ping me if you need sample credit memo language or invoice access.

Priya (Finance): Good progress. I'll publish the updated action tracker after Ashwin confirms final numbers and we'll schedule a short exec update"
